subject: Geo loss-leader mitigation & channel retention for Niagara Health private offer
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@niagarahealth.org>, Chris Lane <chris.lane@healthtech-reseller.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Geo loss-leader mitigation & channel retention for Niagara Health private offer

Hi Amit / Chris —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Quick follow-up with a proposed structure that addresses two things you flagged: (1) we want to provide a compelling private-offer discount for Niagara Health at launch, and (2) your reseller partner needs to preserve healthy netback / margin so they remain incented to support deployment.

High-level proposal attached (niagara_privoffer_draft_v2.pdf) and a short margin workback (niagara_margin_workback.xlsx). Key points:

- List-price anchor: we propose keeping the public Marketplace listing at current list price and issuing a Geo-scoped private-offer discount for Niagara (US-only) to avoid global listprice arbitrage.
- Loss-leader guardrail: a partner netback floor of 18% post-pass-through (brokerage/transaction fees excluded) so Chris's reseller can keep economics intact.
- Commit phasing: 6-month ramp (25/35/40%) to reduce immediate unit-loss risk.
- Onboarding credit: 10% one-time onboarding credit to offset first-90-day integration costs (applies only to Niagara and is accounted for as a rebate so channel can claim).
- SKU shelving: we will map reserved_capacity SKU separately from metered token SKU so partner pass-throughs remain transparent.

Asks: can you confirm (a) that the geo boundary and reseller uplift approach are acceptable to Procurement, and (b) whether Chris needs a separate pass-through invoice path? If yes we can add an invoice routing clause in the private-offer.

Attachments: niagara_privoffer_draft_v2.pdf (private-offer draft, redlines welcome), niagara_margin_workback.xlsx (channel netback workback).

Thanks — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Exec, Cloud & Marketplace
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0133
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Amit Shah <amit.shah@niagarahealth.org>, Chris Lane <chris.lane@healthtech-reseller.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Geo loss-leader mitigation & channel retention for Niagara Health private offer

Tessa — thanks for the clear proposal and the workback. A few notes from a pricing/ops POV after I ran the workbook:

- Partner netback floor: 18% post-pass-through looks reasonable but we should add a clause that allows a single-point downward exception (GM approval) if Niagara requests a promotional exchange within 90 days. That protects against mid-deal marketing events.
- Onboarding credit accounting: recommend we classify the 10% as a deferred credit applied to usage invoices over first two billing cycles rather than a single rebate. Easier for Marketplace reconciliation and reduces immediate cash P&L hit.
- Loss-leader detection: ops can flag any SKU where unit economics go below a configurable threshold for more than 2 consecutive billing periods; that will trigger a review and potential listprice reversion.
- Invoice routing: Chris — we can set up reseller passthrough with Marketplace invoice splitting for the resellers that support Niagara. It requires vendor-side mapping which takes ~5 business days.

I attached a small change to the workbook (column "effective_netback_after_credit") where the deferred-credit amortization is modeled.

If Procurement signs off on geo-scoped private-offer + deferred credit amortization, we can push a dry-run to Billing and Ops this week and get the DocuSign link ready.

-Ben

Attachments: niagara_margin_workback.xlsx (updated column).

--
Ben Carter
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Amit Shah <amit.shah@niagarahealth.org>
Cc: Chris Lane <chris.lane@healthtech-reseller.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T13:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Geo loss-leader mitigation & channel retention for Niagara Health private offer

Appreciate the detail. From legal/contract side a couple quick asks: 

- Add a carve-out that private-offer discount is specifically scoped to "Niagara Health Systems (legal entity ID: NIAG-001)" to avoid accidental cross-account redemption.
- Define "partner netback floor" formula explicitly in section 4 (netback = seller price - reseller fee - pass-through taxes - marketplace commissions).
- Procurement clause: include an explicit acceptance window for the onboarding credit (Procurement must accept within 10 business days or credit is void).

I'll draft the redlines and drop them into the PDF. If Ops is good with deferred amortization, Legal is fine with that flow.

-Vanessa

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Channel Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@niagarahealth.org>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@niagarahealth.org>, Chris Lane <chris.lane@healthtech-reseller.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-15T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Geo loss-leader mitigation & channel retention for Niagara Health private offer

Tessa / Ben / Vanessa —

Thanks for the quick turn. Procurement reviewed the approach and we are generally aligned with the geo-scoped private-offer and the partner netback floor. A couple items from our side: 

- Procurement asks that the deferred onboarding credit be shown on the first invoice as a line-item credit schedule. That helps our finance team tie it out.
- We accept the 6-month commit phasing but request that the first-month consumption not count toward overage thresholds (we expect initial integration spikes).
- Chris: can you confirm that your reseller will accept the 18% netback floor and the deferred credit mechanics?

Assuming those are OK, we can sign the private-offer and ask you to send the DocuSign link.

Thanks — Amit
